title: flindersia oxleyana
intro: Flindersia oxleyana, commonly known as the Queensland boxwood or Oxley boxwood, is a species of tree in the family Rutaceae. This plant is native to the subtropical and tropical regions of Australia and has been used in traditional medicine for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Flindersia oxleyana include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which have been shown to aid in wound healing, reduce pain and inflammation, and protect against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of Flindersia oxleyana include flavonoids, coumarins, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antioxidant effects.
